title: Chunk embeddings RLS plan
description: Covers deny-by-default RLS expectations for chunk_embeddings. Raw embedding vectors have no student-facing surface, so every operation is denied for the authenticated role; only the service-role worker plane reads or writes this table.

cases.name: student cannot select own chunk embeddings
student cannot select another student's chunk embeddings
student cannot insert own chunk embedding
student cannot update own chunk embedding
student cannot delete own chunk embedding

ownership_notes: chunk_embeddings are student-owned derived artifacts versioned by embedding_strategy_version
chunk_embeddings reference public.chunks through same-student composite ownership
chunk_embeddings reference public.resources through same-student composite ownership
no authenticated select, insert, update, or delete policy exists in Stage 12 Group 2 (ENG-304 secure default)
worker mutation and future Group 3 retrieval search rely on service-role bypass
raw embedding vectors are never rendered in any student-facing surface
index_notes: student_id is indexed directly and is mandatory for vector search pre-filtering (ENG-171, SEC-290)
student_id, resource_id composite index supports resource-scoped retrieval
embedding_strategy_version is indexed for controlled re-embedding backfills
an HNSW cosine index on embedding supports approximate nearest neighbour search
